build_ijepa_module: build a python module to instantiate IJEPAModule with an encoder, predictor, and optimizer config for self-supervised learning
create_sample_masks: create a function that calls sample_masks on an IJEPAModule to generate encoder and predictor masks for a batch of images
run_forward_pass: run the forward pass of IJEPAModule with image tensor and masks to compute smooth L1 prediction loss
test_training_step: test the training_step method of IJEPAModule to verify SSL loss computation and online probe reconstruction
review_configure_optimizers: review the configure_optimizers method of IJEPAModule to understand weight decay grouping and scheduler setup
